description: Return every ApexCharts chart type this server supports, with name, description, family (cartesian/bar/financial/circular/grid/radar/unit), series format (axis vs non-axis), expected data shape, the reference doc filename for deeper detail, and `bundle`: { tier: 1 } for a type the default bundle has, or for a Tier 2 type { tier: 2, import, scripts, since, failure, note? } naming the add-on it needs. Optionally filter by family.

family.description: Optional family filter. Omit to return all supported types.

name: apexcharts_list_types
title: List supported chart types
